The Forbidden Islands are an archipelago of islands north-west of Vandura.
Goroma is the largest of the Forbidden Islands and is home to a curious Voodoo Cult.

Grimvale is a small island located north-east of Stonehome and Edron.
Helheim is a small island to the north-east of Hrodmir.
The largest of the all the Ice Islands, Hrodmir is found in the group of the Northern Ice Islands, which were implemented with the 8.0 update.
The Ice Islands are two sets of islands to the north of the main Tibia continent, in the Nordic Ocean.
The Island of Destiny was introduced in Update 8.2, and was designed as a place for new players to decide and get used to their chosen vocations.

Malada is the southern-most island of the Forbidden Islands.
Marapur is an enchanting archipelago located south of Roshamuul and east of Ankrahmun.

Mistrock is one of the islands south-west of Yalahar.

Ramoa is the island located in the north-west of Goroma.

Roshamuul is the name of an island located east of Darashia.

Senja is an Ice Island situated in the Nordic Ocean and it is the isle of the archipelago closest to the continent.
The Shattered Isles are a group of islands west of the island of Darama, and south of the Mainland.
Talahu, otherwise known as Hydra Island, is as the alternate name would suggest, crawling with Hydras.

Tyrsung is a small island to the south-east of Hrodmir.
Vandura is the largest of the Shattered Isles.
One of the three Ice Islands in the north-west of Carlin.
